PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Settings.MarketLevelMo: Determines whether the market cap is derived from the party, fixed to a specific value, or removed entirely.

PF2E_MARKET_FORGE.Settings.MarketLevelOf: Added after rounding for party-derived modes. Example: +1 allows items one level above the resolved party level.
